1 # Yos 3.16; 2.24 Na Amorifoɔ ahene a wɔwɔ Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam no nyinaa ne Kanaan ahemfo a wɔwɔ ɛpo ano no nyinaa tee sɛ AWURADE awe Yordan nsuo Israelfoɔ no anim akɔsi sɛ wɔtwaeɛ no, wɔn akoma tui a na ɔhome bi nni wɔn mu bio Israelfoɔ no anim.
Ɔman twetiatwa ne Twam afahyɛ
2 # Eks 4.25 Saa berɛ no ara na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yɛ twerɛboɔ asekan, na sane twitwa Israelfoɔ no twetia a ɛtɔ so mmienu. 3Na Yosua yɛɛ twerɛboɔ asekan de twitwaa Israelfoɔ no twetia Aaralot kokoɔ so. 4Na deɛ enti a Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia ne sɛ: Ɔman no a wɔfiri Misraim baeɛ no mu mmarima nyinaa, akofoɔ no nyinaa wuwuu kwan mu wɔ serɛ so, wɔfiri Misraim firiiɛ no akyi. 5Nanso ɔman no a wɔfiri Misraim firiiɛ no akyire wɔwoo wɔn kwan mu wɔ serɛ soɔ no nyinaa deɛ, na wɔntwitwaa wɔn twetia. 6#Num 14.22-23 Mfirinhyia aduanan na Israelfoɔ no nantee ɛserɛ soɔ kɔsii sɛ akofoɔ a wɔfiri Misraim baeɛ no nyinaa saa korakora, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantie AWURADE nne maa AWURADE kaa wɔn ntam sɛ wɔrenhunu asase a AWURADE kaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ. 7Na wɔn mma na ɔmaa wɔsɔre sii wɔn ananmu; wɔn na Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia, na wɔyɛ momonoto, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantwitwa wɔn twetia ɔkwan no mu. 8Na wɔwiee ɔman mu no nyinaa twetiatwa no, wɔtenaa wɔn tenabea hɔ nsraban no mu kɔsii sɛ wɔn ho tɔɔ wɔn. 9Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Ɛnnɛ mamuni Misraim nsopa afiri mo so. Ɛno nti wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Gilgal#5.9 GILGAL: Ɛbɛn Hebri kasa Galal a asekyerɛ ne Omuni. de bɛsi nnɛ yi ara.
10 # Eks 12.6; Lew 23.5 Na Israelfoɔ no kyeree nsraban Gilgal, na wɔdii Twam no, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, Yeriko mpaperɛ so. 11Na Twam no akyi, adeɛ kyeeɛ no, da no ara, na wɔdii asase no so aduane, apiti ne nkyeweɛ.
Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ no
12 # Eks 16.35 Na mana no to twae firi da a wɔdii asase no so aduane no, adeɛ kyeeɛ, na Israelfoɔ no annya mana bio, na wɔdii Kanaan asase no so nnɔbaeɛ afe no ara mu.
13 # Num 22.23, 31 Na Yosua wɔ Yeriko ho no, ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi gyina ne ntentensoɔ kura nkrantɛ a watwe. Na Yosua kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wowɔ yɛn afa anaa yɛn atamfoɔ afa? 14#Eks 14.19 Na ɔse: Dabi, na afei na maba sɛ AWURADE dɔm so safohene. Na Yosua de n’anim butuu fam sɔree no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me wura reka akyerɛ n’akoa? 15#Eks 3.5 Na AWURADE dɔm so safohene no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yi wo mpaboa firi wo nan, na deɛ wogyina hɔ yɛ kronkron. Na Yosua yɛɛ saa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Amorifoɔ ahene a wɔwɔ Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam no nyinaa ne Kanaan ahemfo a wɔwɔ ɛpo ano no nyinaa tee sɛ AWURADE awe Yordan nsuo Israelfoɔ no anim akɔsi sɛ wɔtwaeɛ no, wɔn akoma tui a na ɔhome bi nni wɔn mu bio Israelfoɔ no anim.

Saa berɛ no ara na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yɛ twerɛboɔ asekan, na sane twitwa Israelfoɔ no twetia a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Na Yosua yɛɛ twerɛboɔ asekan de twitwaa Israelfoɔ no twetia Aaralot kokoɔ so. Na deɛ enti a Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia ne sɛ: Ɔman no a wɔfiri Misraim baeɛ no mu mmarima nyinaa, akofoɔ no nyinaa wuwuu kwan mu wɔ serɛ so, wɔfiri Misraim firiiɛ no akyi. Nanso ɔman no a wɔfiri Misraim firiiɛ no akyire wɔwoo wɔn kwan mu wɔ serɛ soɔ no nyinaa deɛ, na wɔntwitwaa wɔn twetia. Mfirinhyia aduanan na Israelfoɔ no nantee ɛserɛ soɔ kɔsii sɛ akofoɔ a wɔfiri Misraim baeɛ no nyinaa saa korakora, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantie AWURADE nne maa AWURADE kaa wɔn ntam sɛ wɔrenhunu asase a AWURADE kaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ. Na wɔn mma na ɔmaa wɔsɔre sii wɔn ananmu; wɔn na Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia, na wɔyɛ momonoto, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantwitwa wɔn twetia ɔkwan no mu. Na wɔwiee ɔman mu no nyinaa twetiatwa no, wɔtenaa wɔn tenabea hɔ nsraban no mu kɔsii sɛ wɔn ho tɔɔ wɔn. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Ɛnnɛ mamuni Misraim nsopa afiri mo so. Ɛno nti wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Gilgal de bɛsi nnɛ yi ara.
Na Israelfoɔ no kyeree nsraban Gilgal, na wɔdii Twam no, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ, Yeriko mpaperɛ so. Na Twam no akyi, adeɛ kyeeɛ no, da no ara, na wɔdii asase no so aduane, apiti ne nkyeweɛ.

Na mana no to twae firi da a wɔdii asase no so aduane no, adeɛ kyeeɛ, na Israelfoɔ no annya mana bio, na wɔdii Kanaan asase no so nnɔbaeɛ afe no ara mu.
Na Yosua wɔ Yeriko ho no, ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi gyina ne ntentensoɔ kura nkrantɛ a watwe. Na Yosua kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wowɔ yɛn afa anaa yɛn atamfoɔ afa? Na ɔse: Dabi, na afei na maba sɛ AWURADE dɔm so safohene. Na Yosua de n’anim butuu fam sɔree no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me wura reka akyerɛ n’akoa? Na AWURADE dɔm so safohene no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yi wo mpaboa firi wo nan, na deɛ wogyina hɔ yɛ kronkron. Na Yosua yɛɛ saa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
